title: font_merge_fallback failure paths leak the main/fallback glyph arrays and per-glyph bitmaps
detail: On the ferr/missing_n==len(cps) returns, glyphs (LoadFontData array + ~95 stbtt bitmaps) is never freed; on merged==nil, fg leaks; the completeness-fail MemFree(merged) leaks glyphs, fg, and every glyph bitmap. The ferr path runs on every negative-control test.
recommended_fix: Free before each error return: rl.UnloadFontData(glyphs, count) on the ferr/none/merged-nil paths; free fg's block there; on completeness-fail free glyphs, fg, and merged blocks (UnloadFontData-style per-glyph frees).

title: font_test teardown frees only glyph-array blocks — per-glyph bitmaps, recs, and discarded fonts leak
evidence:
defer rl.MemFree(glyphs) // test-side: the merged glyph block is raylib-owned (r3 note)
...
	_, atlas, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
	if ok {
		rl.UnloadImage(atlas) // note (r4): the guard test discards the atlas — free it
	}
...
	defer rl.UnloadImage(am)
	body, ab, okb := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
	if !okb {
		testing.expect(t, false, "the committed body font must load")
		return
	}
	defer rl.UnloadImage(ab)
detail: MemFree(glyphs) frees only the array; raylib frees glyphs[i].image.data per glyph solely via UnloadFontData (rtext.c:993-1000, exposed as rl.UnloadFontData). Guard/tabular tests discard whole fonts — glyph arrays, recs, bitmaps all leak. Raylib-side memory, so the tracking allocator never sees it.
recommended_fix: Replace MemFree(glyphs) with rl.UnloadFontData(glyphs, count); in the guard/tabular tests also UnloadFontData the returned fonts' glyphs and MemFree their recs, alongside the existing atlas UnloadImage calls.
